title: Touhou Gouyoku Ibun ~ Sunken Fossil World - The Great Pillars of War 🍁 ~ The Venerable Ancient Battlefield (Remix)
description:
❝ 𝐀 𝐠𝐨𝐝 𝐦𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐨𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐠𝐠𝐥𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡, 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐛𝐲 𝐨𝐧𝐞. ❞
ㅤ- Kanako Yasaka, 東方風神録 ~ Mountain of Faith (2007)

ㅤㅤ


Did an arrangement of Kanako Yasaka's theme, The Venerable Ancient Battlefield ~ Suwa Foughten Field, from Touhou 17.5 Gouyoku Ibun ~ Sunken Fossil World (originally from Touhou 10 Fuujinroku ~ Mountain of Faith). It's been a hot minute since my last Touhou remix (which is crazy given how addicted I am to Touhou music). I'm in the mood for some intense (and I mean INTENSE) final boss music, and Kanako Yasaka has me covered in that regard. I did her stage theme five years ago, and now it's time to do her actual theme song.

I've always been a huge fan of her SFW theme. It's way more sinister and intense than the original and feels more fitting for the ruthless Pillar Woman.

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Decreased Echo Delay (LOWER Echo)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤㅤ ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7) ← ("JV-1080 Creamy Guitar Lead.brr" is in its place in case you really need it)
ㅤㅤㅤ - "P-Switch" (@12) ← ("S-550 LA Tom.brr" is in its place in case you really need it)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Yoshi SFX (@15)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. C Minor (Gouyoku Ibun Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. C# Minor (Mountain of Faith Pitch)
